title: slipstream.session.resumed.v1
$comment: Recorded at recovered_through_seq + 1 when capture of an existing session resumes (daemon restart or re-attach). It resets live state: there is no current task until a new task.started, questions queued before it are never claimable again, and any earlier agent.connection record is stale. capture_mode watch-only means this activation was started without a chat (attach --watch-only, or recovery of such a capture); absent means a chat attach started it, and watch-only is never inferred from absence. A later chat link never rewrites it. Self-contained; unknown fields permitted for forward compatibility.
